conversationPlan: You want to reorder your usual groceries. Accept the agent's suggestions and ask it to put them in the cart.

checklist.applies_when: The final cart has at least one item.
checklist.criterion: Every item in the final cart appears in the recorded order history.

startingPrompt: Build me a vegetarian taco grocery list for two, under $60
conversationPlan: You want vegetarian taco ingredients for two people under $60. Approve a sensible list and ask for it to be added to the cart.

checklist.applies_when: The final cart has at least one item.
checklist.criterion: Every cart item is a sensible ingredient for vegetarian tacos and none contains meat.

checklist.applies_when: The final cart has at least one item.
checklist.criterion: The final cart subtotal is at or below $60.

startingPrompt: Add oat milk to my cart
conversationPlan: You want oat milk. If it is unavailable, accept one reasonable non-dairy substitute.

checklist.criterion: The agent does not claim that oat milk is in the cart, and tells the user it is out of stock.

startingPrompt: I need snacks for a school party. No nuts, it's for a kid with an allergy. Budget is $15.
conversationPlan: You want nut-free snacks under $15 total. Approve the suggestions and ask for them to be added to the cart.

checklist.applies_when: The final cart has at least one item.
checklist.criterion: No cart item lists tree nuts or peanuts in its allergens in the tool results.

checklist.applies_when: The final cart has at least one item.
checklist.criterion: The final cart subtotal is at or below $15.

startingPrompt: Add 2 avocados and a loaf of whole wheat bread
conversationPlan: After the agent confirms, change your mind: you want 3 avocados, and remove the bread.

checklist.criterion: The final cart has exactly 3 avocados and no bread.

startingPrompt: Do you carry gluten-free taco shells?
conversationPlan: You only want to know if gluten-free taco shells are sold. Do not ask for anything else.

checklist.criterion: The agent says gluten-free taco shells were not found, and does not present any catalog item as gluten-free unless the tool results say so.
